method: Original composition guides rendered as botanical card backs

specs.name: The Olive Seal
specs.detail: Two small opposed dark-lapis oval seals sit in the upper and lower thirds, each containing a slender ivory olive sprig with THREE finely modelled narrow leaves and ONE tiny gold fruit, matching the simple emblem in the wireframe. The two seals are connected by a graceful interlaced botanical network through the middle. Replace the guide's bare crossing loops with exquisite fine blue olive stems, small leaves and hairline gold inflections, threaded naturally around the seals and corners. Fill the surrounding field with a quiet, fine connected olive diaper pattern, a few dozen small motifs, no empty halo. The seals are subordinate to the complete back. Fine double perimeter, one continuous botanical rhythm, refined leaf contours.
specs.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Create a finished, beautifully designed TWO-WAY TAROT CARD BACK for Olivia Arcana. Input image 1 is a simple composition wireframe: use its hierarchy, motif sizes, main routes and fine continuous border as guidance, but develop it into a much richer, exquisitely drawn original botanical ornamental artwork. Input image 2 is ONLY a reference for the lapis-blue, carved ivory, restrained gold materials that belong to this deck; DO NOT reproduce its large trees, landscape or empty central scene. This must immediately read as the REVERSE of a collectible playing card, with a unified ornamental surface and 180-degree rotational composition, not a narrative tarot face or a picture framed by branches. All directional olive motifs occur in opposed pairs. Fine engraving carries the interest across the whole field. Main motifs modest in size, no oversized objects, no huge blank central area. Interwoven stems flow continuously through the field and into the four corners. Three detail scales: a readable overall two-way structure; beautifully spaced smaller botanical motifs; extremely fine engraved micro-lines. Delicate slender olive leaves, tapering stems, thoughtful over/under connections. Materials: rich midnight-lapis blue with quiet coherent mineral grain; shallow incised blue-on-blue ornament with gently catching edges; ivory only in small meaningful details; very fine selective muted gold inlays. Relief is subordinate to the pattern, maximum impression of shallow engraving, no strong protruding objects or deep object shadows. Balanced illumination, neither end noticeably brighter. Authentic tactile finish with a clean, narrowly rounded rectangular edge, no fake heavy distress. Final image portrait 7:12, entire complete flat card-back texture edge-to-edge, perfectly straight-on, no perspective/mockup/table. No text, letters, numbers, title, watermark, people, hands, faces, birds, trees as subjects, pool, horizon, scene, large ivory sculpture, glowing portal, broad gold stroke, glitzy border, constellation, sunburst or generic occult icon. The flat wireframe is not the final surface style: enrich its restrained structure with precise botanical engraving and material detail. The final should remain recognisable and balanced when shrunk to the size of a physical card.

specs.name: The Paired Sprigs
specs.detail: Develop the two opposed elongated loops in the guide into a single continuous double-ended olive garland. Thin stems exchange sides at the narrow central waist, forming two graceful almond openings, without a thick central knot. The leaves are slender carved blue and occur in carefully spaced rhythmic clusters, with tiny restrained ivory highlights. Within each opening the modest olive sprig motif is lightly engraved, not a large badge. Small botanical tendrils fill spaces between the main oval route and the perimeter, connecting through the corners. Dense fine engraving in select spaces, quiet dark blue small intervals throughout. Sophisticated playing-card back, classical ornament with precise delicate botanical character.

specs.name: The Olive Cameo
specs.detail: Two SMALL opposed oval ivory cameos in the upper and lower thirds, each approximately 15 percent of the card height, set flush into the field rather than heavily protruding. In each cameo, a delicate olive sprig is engraved in shallow blue, with three lanceolate leaves and one very small gold fruit. Develop the connecting diagonal routes of the wireframe into fine crossing botanical bands, a meticulously engraved blue-lapis lattice that is continuous across the whole back and folds through the corners. Vary the spacing subtly near the cameos so they belong to the pattern. Very fine coin-like engraving at cameo edges, never fat gold rims. The warm ivory is a restrained punctuation in a rich dark-blue engraved card back, not a pair of portrait plaques.
